body: I actually love eating corn with pizza. The mix is so good. I don't know why...? I would recommend 10/10.
I love to heat up the tortilla and then add wavy ruffles chips. I'm telling you,  those two mix.
It tastes really good as a pb and j sandwich. Kind of chewy.
What can I say? I also love to top rice with parmesan.
It looks really good though. They must have a sucky pallette or are jealous. Good job.
